title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-samira-patel-aaron-li-2026-03-30
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep — Aaron Li (AE)
Date: 2026-03-30
Location: Zoom / async notes
Duration: 30m

Purpose:
- Quick alignment on top accounts, risks, and enablement needs.
- Confirm next steps for three priority customers (AtlasHealth, Finlytics, EduWave).
- Remove blockers for onboarding and renewals pipeline.

Agenda (proposed):
1) Quick wins / wins since last 1:1 (3-4m)
   - AtlasHealth: Completed SSO validation; infra team signed off on data retention config.
   - EduWave: Prototype integration live in sandbox, initial latency numbers look good (p50 ~120ms on dedicated).
2) Top account health (10m)
   - AtlasHealth (expansion, pilot -> paid): Aaron to confirm final internal security signoff timeline. Risk: legal review may add 2-3 weeks.
   - Finlytics (renewal Q3): Usage dipped 25% last month; possible performance cost concerns. Action: propose batching profile + cost forecast (Samira).
   - EduWave (new pilot): Need to finalize model pin + logging policy for student PII. Aaron to share example policy.
3) Technical blockers / infra asks (7m)
   - Request for dedicated preemptible pool for EduWave spike testing — need SRE estimate. Follow-up: open infra ticket (INF-3341).
   - Observability gap: customer wants token-level cost breakdown for last 30 days; propose a short export + call.
4) Enablement / enablement material needed (5m)
   - Create one-pager: "Reducing inference cost w/ batching & caching" — due EOD Thu. Owner: Samira.
   - Quick demo checklist for AE to show model pinning + rollbacks in Console.
5) Wrap / action items (up to 5m)

Prep notes / context to bring to the meeting:
- AtlasHealth: legal flagged data residency clause. Aaron introduced to security two weeks ago; no updates since last sync. Suggest offering to host private deployment in us-west-2 region as short-term concession.
- Finlytics: finance contacted support about spikes in token spend during heavy reporting windows. Hypothesis: unbatched streaming + multiple concurrent small requests. Recommend try: 1) add prefix caching for repeated prompts, 2) increase batching window to 50ms for background report jobs.
- EduWave: product wants a "student PII safe-mode" — disable embeddings + redact logs for specific routes. Need to map console controls to policy language.

Open questions to ask Aaron:
- Which of the three accounts are highest priority for you this week?
- Any blockers from your side on coordinating security/legal for AtlasHealth?
- Are there any upcoming customer demos where we should optimize latency/response format?
- Does AE team have bandwidth for cross-functional call with SRE next Tue?

Action items (draft — assign during 1:1):
- Samira: Draft cost-reduction one-pager and sample config snippets for batching/caching (due 2026-04-01).
- Samira: Prepare Finlytics cost forecast (3 scenarios: baseline, after batching, after caching) and short slide for AE (due 2026-04-02).
- Aaron: Confirm AtlasHealth legal/security timeline and whether private deployment offer is required (update by 2026-04-03).
- Aaron: Share EduWave logging/policy example doc and coordinate with product for PII safe-mode requirements (by 2026-04-02).
- Samira + SRE: Open INF-3341 ticket requesting preemptible pool for EduWave spike test and include capacity/estimate ask (by 2026-03-31).
- Samira: Schedule follow-up customer call with Finlytics after cost forecast is ready (target week of 2026-04-06).

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Keep conversation focused on measurable outcomes (renewal probability, expansion ARR, cost delta).
- Bring quick screenshots of Console batching toggle + example rollout policy.
- If Aaron is pressed for time, prioritize Finlytics and AtlasHealth.

Follow-up / post-meeting plan (template):
- Send 1:1 notes + action items within 24h.
- Attach one-pager + cost forecast to AE thread and Confluence summary.
- If legal / security asks escalate, loop in Product-Security (cc: Avery Chen).

Relevant links / refs:
- Confluence: Customer playbook — onboarding checklist: /pages/viewpage.action?pageId=8765432
- Jira: INF-3341 (preemptible pool request), JIRA-INF-2345 (AtlasHealth security signoff)
- Internal PR: github.com/redwood-inference/reports/pull/78 (Finlytics cost analysis draft)

Estimated time budget for tasks this week:
- One-pager + snippets: 3-4h
- Finlytics forecast: 2-3h (with run of sample traces)
- Infra ticket / SRE sync: 30-60m

Tone / ask guidance for Aaron:
- Be direct about timeline constraints for legal/security — ask for commitment date rather than open-ended updates.
- For Finlytics, push for a short technical call with their engineering lead to run live trace sampling — usually moves things faster than email.

-- end --
